query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Publish approved carousel content from a Trello workflow to LinkedIn, add a first comment, update Trello status/logs, and adjust the Trello board workflow structure.
query_ground_truth.query: modify Trello board lists and workflow structure

requirement_groups.purpose: add new lists to adjust the board workflow

query_ground_truth.rationale: This query covers the board-level structural adjustments required by the workflow, specifically adding new lists.

request.query: modify Trello board lists and workflow structure

results.use_case: modify Trello board lists and workflow structure
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if board identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Action using TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER (find the target board identifier).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Action using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD (map current list names to list identifiers and capture current order).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Action using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD_BY_FILTER (enumerate cards and current list identifiers for moves).
[Required] [Step]: Action using TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST (apply list renames/attribute changes needed for the target structure).
[Required] [Step]: Action using TRELLO_ADD_LISTS (create any missing lists needed for the new workflow).
[Required] [Step]: Action using TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_POS_BY_ID_LIST (set positions to enforce the desired list ordering across affected lists).
[Required] [Step]: Action using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD (move each selected card by updating its destination list identifier).
[Optional (for verification after writes)] [Next Step]: Action using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD (re-fetch lists to confirm final names and ordering).

[Fallback (if a card move fails with 404)] [Fallback]: Action using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD (validate the card exists and read its current list), then retry using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD (apply the move).
known_pitfalls: [TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD] Lists may be nested under response.data.lists; an empty lists result can be valid (e.g., empty board or incorrect board identifier).
[TRELLO_ADD_LISTS] Requested list placement/pos can be normalized by the server; confirm the actual ordering and adjust with TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST or TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_POS_BY_ID_LIST.

[TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_POS_BY_ID_LIST] Reordering is only deterministic if you set positions for all lists whose relative order should change; updating just one list can leave the rest effectively unchanged.
[TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD] Moves can fail with 404 when the card identifier is invalid; validate with TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD before retrying.
[TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST] Bulk updates based on stale state can cause unintended changes; if uncertain, confirm the current list fields first with TRELLO_GET_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST.

TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD.description: Retrieves lists from a specified Trello board, with options to filter lists and include card details.

cards.description: Determines which cards should be returned within the lists. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

fields.description: Specifies the fields of the lists to be returned. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: closed, idBoard, name, pos, or subscribed.

filter.description: Filters the lists to be returned based on their status. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board. Valid formats: 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '60d5f2f1c8a8b4002b8f0123') OR 8-character shortLink (e.g., 'TH6F0pTM'). Human-readable board names or URL slugs (e.g., 'my-board', 'tech-jcorp') are NOT valid identifiers. In the URL 'trello.com/b/TH6F0pTM/my-board', 'TH6F0pTM' is the valid shortLink, while 'my-board' is just a slug and cannot be used. To find your board ID or shortLink: use TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER to list your boards, or look at the board URL in your browser.

card_fields.description: Specifies the fields of cards to be returned if the 'cards' parameter is not 'none'. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, or url.

TRELLO_ADD_LISTS.description: Creates a new list on a specified Trello board, with options to copy an existing list, set its position, initial state (archived/subscribed), and does not modify existing lists or move cards.

pos.description: The position of the new list on the board. Valid values are `top`, `bottom`, or a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5').

name.description: The name for the new list. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters. This is a required parameter.

closed.description: Indicates whether the list should be created as closed (archived). Set to `true` for closed, or `false` for open.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to which the new list should be added. This is a required parameter.

subscribed.description: Indicates whether the user creating the list should be automatically subscribed to it. Set to `true` to subscribe, or `false` otherwise.

idListSource.description: The ID of an existing list to copy when creating the new list. If provided, the new list will be a copy of this source list.

TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST.description: Updates attributes of an existing Trello list, such as name, position, archive status, board, or copies cards from another list, provided the list `idList` exists.

pos.description: New position for the list on the board (e.g., 'top', 'bottom', '1', '1024.5').

name.description: New name for the list (1-16384 characters).

closed.description: Set to 'true' to archive the list, or 'false' to unarchive.

idList.description: The unique identifier of the Trello list to be updated. This ID is a path parameter.

idBoard.description: ID of the board to move the list to.

subscribed.description: Set to 'true' to subscribe the current user, or 'false' to unsubscribe.

idListSource.description: ID of a source list whose cards will be copied to this list.

TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Updates an existing Trello card's attributes like name, description, due date, members, labels, position, or archives/unarchives it, attaches files, or changes its cover.

due.description: The new due date for the card, in ISO 8601 format, or 'null' to remove the due date.

pos.description: The new position of the card within its list. Can be 'top', 'bottom', or a positive floating-point number. Higher numbers are further down the list.

desc.description: The new description for the card. String length must be from 0 to 16384 characters.

name.description: The new name for the card. Required if not copying the name from `idCardSource`, `fileSource`, or `urlSource`.

closed.description: Determines whether the card should be archived (closed). Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to update.

idList.description: The ID of the list to move the card to.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label colors (e.g., 'green,yellow,red') to apply, overwriting existing labels. Use 'idLabels' for more precise control. 'all' may add all available label colors.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to move the card to. If `idList` is also provided, the card will be moved to that list on the new board.

idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to apply, replacing existing labels. To preserve existing labels, fetch current `idLabels`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign, replacing existing members. To preserve existing members, fetch current `idMembers`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

urlSource.description: A URL to be attached to the card (e.g., a link to an external resource). If the card is being created from a URL (e.g. via a bookmarklet), this will be the source URL. Set to 'null' or an empty string to remove an existing attachment link created this way.

fileSource.description: The URL of a file to be attached to the card. Trello will fetch and attach the file from this URL.

subscribed.description: Determines whether the user is subscribed to the card. Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCardSource.description: The ID of a card to copy properties from. Requires `keepFromSource` to be specified.

keepFromSource.description: If `idCardSource` is specified, this is a comma-separated list of properties to copy from the source card. Valid values are 'all', or any combination of 'attachments', 'checklists', 'comments', 'customFields', 'due', 'labels', 'members', 'pluginData', 'stickers'.

idAttachmentCover.description: The ID of an existing image attachment to be used as the card cover. Use 'null' or an empty string to remove the cover.

TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER.description: Retrieves board-level details (not lists/cards) for Trello boards associated with a member ID or username, allowing extensive customization of the returned data.

lists.description: Filters the lists returned for each board. Valid values: 'all', 'closed', 'none', 'open'.

fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for each board. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of field names. Possible field names: 'closed', 'dateLastActivity', 'dateLastView', 'desc', 'descData', 'idOrganization', 'invitations', 'invited', 'labelNames', 'memberships', 'name', 'pinned', 'powerUps', 'prefs', 'shortLink', 'shortUrl', 'starred', 'subscribed', 'url'.

filter.description: Filters the boards returned. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'closed', 'members', 'open', 'organization', 'pinned', 'public', 'starred', 'unpinned'.

actions.description: Specifies which actions to return for each board. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of action types. Possible action types: 'addAttachmentToCard', 'addChecklistToCard', 'addMemberToBoard', 'addMemberToCard', 'addMemberToOrganization', 'addToOrganizationBoard', 'commentCard', 'convertToCardFromCheckItem', 'copyBoard', 'copyCard', 'copyCommentCard', 'createBoard', 'createCard', 'createList', 'createOrganization', 'deleteAttachmentFromCard', 'deleteBoardInvitation', 'deleteCard', 'deleteOrganizationInvitation', 'disablePowerUp', 'emailCard', 'enablePowerUp', 'makeAdminOfBoard', 'makeNormalMemberOfBoard', 'makeNormalMemberOfOrganization', 'makeObserverOfBoard', 'memberJoinedTrello', 'moveCardFromBoard', 'moveCardToBoard', 'moveListFromBoard', 'moveListToBoard', 'removeChecklistFromCard', 'removeFromOrganizationBoard', 'removeMemberFromCard', 'unconfirmedBoardInvitation', 'unconfirmedOrganizationInvitation', 'updateBoard', 'updateCard', 'updateCard:closed', 'updateCard:desc', 'updateCard:idList', 'updateCard:name', 'updateCheckItemStateOnCard', 'updateChecklist', 'updateList', 'updateList:closed', 'updateList:name', 'updateMember', 'updateOrganization'.

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user. Defaults to 'me' if not provided.

memberships.description: Filters boards by the member's membership type. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'active', 'admin', 'deactivated', 'me', 'normal'.

organization.description: Determines whether to return organization data for boards. Valid values: 'true' or 'false'.

action_fields.description: Specifies fields for returned actions if actions are requested. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list: 'data', 'date', 'idMemberCreator', 'type'.

actions_limit.description: The maximum number of actions to return, from 0 to 1000.

actions_since.description: Filters actions to those that occurred after this date, or accepts 'null' or 'lastView'.

actions_format.description: The format for returned actions. Valid values: 'count', 'list', or 'minimal'.

actions_entities.description: Determines whether to return entity data for actions. Valid values: 'true' or 'false'.

organization_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for the organization if 'organization' is 'true'. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of field names. Possible field names: 'billableMemberCount', 'desc', 'descData', 'displayName', 'idBoards', 'invitations', 'invited', 'logoHash', 'memberships', 'name', 'powerUps', 'prefs', 'premiumFeatures', 'products', 'url', 'website'.
